description: This file defines the EmptyRelationExec class, a Spark SQL execution plan node representing an empty relation, used as a leaf node in query plans. It preserves the logical plan and provides methods for execution and plan tree visualization.

classes.name: EmptyRelationExec
classes.description: A Spark SQL execution plan node representing an empty relation, acting as a leaf node that preserves the logical plan and supports execution and plan tree visualization.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Returns an empty RDD of InternalRow for execution.

methods.name: executeCollect
methods.description: Returns an empty array of InternalRow for collect operation.

methods.name: executeTake
methods.description: Returns an empty array of InternalRow for take operation with a specified limit.

methods.name: executeTail
methods.description: Returns an empty array of InternalRow for tail operation with a specified limit.

methods.name: doExecuteColumnar
methods.description: Returns an empty RDD of ColumnarBatch for columnar execution.

methods.name: doCanonicalize
methods.description: Returns a canonicalized version of the plan with a LocalRelation.
